title: CORS Preflight & Credentialed Fetch Flow
description: Trace how a cross-origin JSON POST triggers an OPTIONS preflight and SameSite cookie check.

steps.label: 1. Browser Classifies Request
steps.description: fetch('https://api.example.com/v1', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }) is non-simple because of application/json.

steps.label: 2. OPTIONS Preflight & Cache
steps.description: Browser sends OPTIONS without cookies. Server responds 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://app.example.com, Allow-Credentials: true, and Max-Age: 7200.

steps.label: 3. Actual POST + SameSite Check
steps.description: Browser dispatches the POST. SameSite=None; Secure cookies attach; SameSite=Lax cookies are withheld if cross-site.
